name: CorVita
description: CorVita, derived from the Latin words "Cor" for "Heart" and "Vita" for "Life", is a comprehensive heart health application.

paragraphs: This is a Heart Disease Diagnosis Web App, a user-friendly tool built using Python and Streamlit, featuring a backend machine learning model that predicts heart disease risk based on user inputs like age, gender, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels. Additionally, it integrates the OpenAI API to provide advanced chatbot features, offering personalized health suggestions generated by large language models (LLMs). This combination of predictive analytics and interactive guidance aims to enhance preventive care and support informed decision-making in heart health management.
features: Access to AI suggestions and Chat
